identity.name: Sky-Dweller
identity.one_liner: The platinum Sky-Dweller — the only Rolex with a full-platinum case, an ice-blue dial, and a sandblasted platinum bezel. The top of the Sky-Dweller line.

narrative.story: The 268622 is the platinum Sky-Dweller, sold since 2014 in the catalogue but rarely on the secondary market because of low production. The ice-blue dial is the Rolex signature for platinum: 18k gold is the only other material that gets the ice-blue. The sandblasted bezel is the only Rolex bezel with this finish. The 268622 is the most-cited modern Rolex complication at a price below the Daytona Platinum (116506) and the Day-Date Platinum (m228206).
